full_name: Ana Paiva | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2020–2021 Engineering & Computer Science Katherine Hampson Bessell Fellow University of Lisbon (Portugal)
bio: Ana Paiva is a computer science professor at Instituto Superior Técnico, Universidade de Lisboa, and is investigating the design of intelligent interactive systems by creating “social agents” that can interact with humans in a natural manner.
